summary: Frontend-only latency-sensitive test focused on the newly added PWA + Floating Action Button (FAB) features on top of iteration_1 baseline. Verified PWA assets, mobile viewport usability, FAB quick-add expense (with Disponible antes/después preview + success toast), FAB quick-add income, Categorias available box deduction, Dashboard KPI updates, and FAB visibility on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x800).
passed: manifest.json served at /manifest.json returns 200 with name 'Mis Finanzas - Control de Gastos'
Mobile viewport 390x844: header 'Mis Finanzas' + tabs + FAB visible
FAB toggle opens menu exposing fab-expense-btn and fab-income-btn
Category 'Alimentación' with limit 5000 created via Categorias tab
FAB quick-add expense: amount 1200 + category select works; fab-remaining-hint shows 'Disponible antes: RD$5,000.00' and 'Disponible después: RD$3,800.00'
Success toast after saving expense: 'Gasto registrado. Disponible en "Alimentación": RD$3,800.00'
Categorias page available-{id} box shows 'Disponible RD$3,800.00 24% del límite usado' after expense
FAB quick-add income: 30,000 Salario updates Dashboard kpi-income to RD$30,000.00
Dashboard KPI after transactions: income=RD$30,000.00, expense=RD$1,200.00, balance=RD$28,800.00, ahorro=96%
FAB (fab-toggle) also visible on desktop viewport 1280x800
notes: PWA assets confirmed via curl (200 OK). Deeper checks not exercised in this iteration but already covered in iteration_1: over-limit alert, goals progress, currency switch to USD, CSV/PDF export, localStorage persistence, month selector. Pure client-side app; no backend endpoints touched.
